name: CodeUpdate-0044-Original-Reference-Extractor
purpose: Add a reference-only original data capture/extractor tool so legacy Worldgroup, WCC, WBB, WSGSERVE, and related source material can be inventoried before reviewed data reconciliation.
milestone2Status: Continuing with constrained host/server, reference capture, and data-readiness work; no gameplay systems are approved.
verificationStatus: PowerShell extractor self-test passed against Tools/ReferenceCapture/README.md and temporary self-test output was removed. Local .NET verification is pending until final verification commands complete. GitHub Actions remains pending after user push.

localVerification.scope: Reference-only original data capture tool and continuity documentation
localVerification.powerShellSelfTest: Capture-OriginalReferenceData.ps1 completed against Tools/ReferenceCapture/README.md, produced one file inventory and 35 string rows, and temporary self-test output was removed.
localVerification.restore: No restore was required; no package references changed.

boundaries: No imported/reference overwrite outside named capture outputs
No original EXE, DLL, COM, or SYS execution
referenceDataPolicy: All WCC, WBB, WSGSERVE, Worldgroup, website, community, and tool-derived data remains reference-only unless the user explicitly approves a reviewed import/reconciliation update.
importedDataRetirementPolicy: ImportedDatabases may be retired from normal project work only after all needed source data has been decoded, imported, recreated as Reforged-native Data, verified by reports, and explicitly approved for cleanup.
knownLimitations: The extractor inventories files, hashes, category hints, and printable strings; it does not yet decode every proprietary binary record into structured Reforged data.
.rar and .7z extraction requires 7-Zip to be installed or the user to provide a manually extracted folder.
Capture outputs are reference evidence only and must not overwrite canonical Data without a reviewed follow-up update.
recommendedNextUpdate: After CodeUpdate-0044 is pushed and GitHub Actions is green, use the extractor outputs with ChatGPT for actual extraction analysis, then approve one narrow reviewed parser/comparison or server data-readiness slice.
